problems.quote: exactly one follows if the premises are consistent
problems.problem: For a contradictory pair of conclusions, it is not guaranteed that exactly one follows from consistent premises; neither may follow (e.g., premises 'Some A are B' yield neither 'All A are B' nor 'Some A are not B').
problems.correction: at most one follows if the premises are consistent
problems.verifierReason: Original claims exactly one of contradictory pair follows from consistent premises; actually at most one follows, neither may follow. Correction accurate.

problems.quote: Some non‑students are not teachers” is the contrapositive of “Some teachers are not students”
problems.problem: The contrapositive of 'Some teachers are not students' (Some T are not S) is 'Some non-students are not non-teachers' (Some non-S are not non-T), not 'Some non-students are not teachers'.
problems.correction: Some non‑students are not non‑teachers” is the contrapositive of “Some teachers are not students”
problems.verifierReason: Contrapositive of Some T are not S is Some non-S are not non-T, not Some non-S are not T. Correction fixes.

problems.quote: it is distributed in (1) (subject of A)
problems.problem: In 'All A are B', the term B is the predicate, not the subject; the subject A is distributed, but B is undistributed.
problems.correction: it is undistributed in (1) (predicate of A)
problems.verifierReason: In All A are B, predicate B is undistributed, not distributed; quote mislabels as subject. Correction correct.

problems.problem: Command substitution in bash uses `$(...)` or backticks, not `(...)` which creates a subshell.
problems.verifierReason: Original uses subshell syntax; correction gives correct command substitution syntax.

problems.quote: The 2023 amendment to the DFCCIL Act empowered the corporation to raise “Green Bonds” up to ₹5,000 crore
problems.problem: There is no 'DFCCIL Act'; DFCCIL is a company incorporated under the Companies Act, not a statute. The green bond issuance was authorized by the government/Cabinet, not by an amendment to a non-existent act.
problems.correction: The 2023 Cabinet approval empowered the corporation to raise “Green Bonds” up to ₹5,000 crore
problems.verifierReason: DFCCIL is a Companies Act entity, not created by a specific Act; Green Bond limit was set by Cabinet/CCEA approval in 2023.
